**Purpose.** Carry the full chain from source evidence to exception path for every step in the estate, so any statement can be walked back to the artifact it rests on.

The chain the standard specifies:

```text
Source Evidence → System or Platform → Module → Feature or Function → Process → Subprocess
→ Process Step → Actor or System → Rule or Control → Input → Output → Status Transition
→ Exception or Recovery Path
```

4060 rows, one per step. Assembled at render time from the step, process and source records
rather than stored separately, so the matrix cannot drift from the catalogues it summarises.
